import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/COSTCO_2015_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts']
patterns=re.compile(r'(total revenue|net sales|revenues?|sales)',re.I)
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if patterns.search(txt):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',txt[:200])
PY"
